code:
"""线上评测: 对照组 vs 实验组的转化率差异是否显著(z 检验)。"""
import math

def z_test(x1, n1, x2, n2):
    p1, p2 = x1 / n1, x2 / n2
    p = (x1 + x2) / (n1 + n2)
    se = math.sqrt(p * (1 - p) * (1 / n1 + 1 / n2))
    z = (p2 - p1) / se if se > 0 else 0.0
    pval = 2 * (1 - 0.5 * (1 + math.erf(abs(z) / math.sqrt(2))))
    return p1, p2, z, pval

print("== 场景A: 样本充足, 差异明显 ==")
p1, p2, z, pv = z_test(x1=400, n1=10000, x2=470, n2=10000)
print("对照转化率=%.4f 实验转化率=%.4f z=%.4f p=%.6f" % (p1, p2, z, pv))
print("显著(p<0.05):", pv < 0.05)

print("== 场景B: 差异小, 不显著 ==")
p1, p2, z, pv = z_test(x1=400, n1=10000, x2=412, n2=10000)
print("对照转化率=%.4f 实验转化率=%.4f z=%.4f p=%.6f" % (p1, p2, z, pv))
print("显著(p<0.05):", pv < 0.05)

print("== 场景C: 样本过小, 谨慎下线 ==")
p1, p2, z, pv = z_test(x1=8, n1=100, x2=15, n2=100)
print("对照转化率=%.4f 实验转化率=%.4f z=%.4f p=%.6f" % (p1, p2, z, pv))
print("显著(p<0.05):", pv < 0.05)
print("小样本显著需延长观测或改用贝叶斯估计: True")
